method: Unchanged original block registry objects 98, 43, 44, 120, 118 and 140 over a minimal World/IBlockAccess double (ahb subclass with a cell map, recorded writes/sounds/spawned items and tile entities), an Unsafe-allocated EntityPlayerMP for ItemSlab.onItemUse, BlockCauldron/BlockFlowerPot onBlockActivated, onEntityCollidedWithBlock and fillWithRain, and TileEntityFlowerPot createNewTileEntity. No render engine, tessellator or WorldServer tick loop is instantiated; glass-bottle and armor-dye cauldron branches are not probed (no bottle item exists in this port).
